bundle_measles/dist/measles_state.parque.short_description: Geographic identifier. In this file geography holds the full state name (e.g. 'California') or 'United States' for national rows, rather than a FIPS code.

vaccine_exemption_rate.short_description: Percentage of kindergartners with non-medical exemptions from MMR vaccination requirements at state level.
vaccine_exemption_rate.long_description: State-level percentage of kindergartners with non-medical exemptions from MMR vaccination requirements. Compiled from state-reported exemption data spanning 2009–2024, covering prepandemic (2009–2019) and postpandemic (2020–2024) periods. Data from Fattah et al. 2026 (JAMA).

cdc_measles_cases_nnds_cum.short_description: Cumulative year-to-date confirmed measles cases per state, from CDC's National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System.
cdc_measles_cases_nnds_cum.long_description: State-level cumulative year-to-date measles case counts derived from CDC's National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS), computed as the sum of imported and indigenous measles cases and carried forward within each surveillance year. National ('United States') rows are excluded from this file.

bundle_measles/dist/measles_county.parqu.short_description: Flag indicating whether a county value is actually a state-level estimate applied to the county (1) rather than a county-specific measurement (0).
bundle_measles/dist/measles_county.parqu.long_description: Indicator (0/1) that a county row carries a state-level estimate rather than a value measured at the county level. Set to 1 when the underlying source only reports at the state level (e.g. some vaccine exemption estimates), and 0 otherwise. Missing values are coded as 0.

vaccine_exemption_rate.long_name: Kindergarten non-medical MMR Vaccine Exemption Rate (County)
vaccine_exemption_rate.short_description: Percentage of kindergartners with non-medical exemptions from MMR vaccination requirements at county level.
vaccine_exemption_rate.long_description: County-level percentage of kindergartners with non-medical exemptions from MMR vaccination requirements. Compiled from state-reported exemption data spanning 2009–2024. County-level coverage varies by state, as not all states report at the county level. Data from Fattah et al. 2026 (JAMA).

bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.short_description: Geographic identifier. This file is national only; geography always holds the value 'United States'.

cdc_measles_cases_vax.short_name: CDC measles cases by vaccination status
cdc_measles_cases_vax.short_description: Rows stratified by vaccination status (vax_group other than 'Total'); measles case/hospitalization counts approximated from CDC-reported percentages by vaccination status.

bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_name: Age group stratification for measles cases
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.short_description: Age group of measles cases. When an age-specific group is shown, vax_group is 'Total'.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_description: Age group stratification for measles case counts. Values include '<5 years', '5-19 years', '20+ years', and 'Total'. When age is one of the age-specific values, vax_group is always 'Total'. When age is 'Total', vax_group varies across vaccination status categories.

bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_name: Vaccination status stratification for measles cases
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.short_description: Vaccination status of measles cases. Only varies when age is 'Total'.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_description: Vaccination status stratification for measles case counts. Values include 'Total', 'Unvaccinated/Unknown', 'One dose MMR', and 'Two doses MMR'. Rows with age-specific groups (<5, 5-19, 20+) always have vax_group set to 'Total'. 'Unvaccinated/Unknown' includes persons with no measles-containing vaccine doses or unknown vaccination history.

bundle_measles/dist/measles_state.parque.short_description: Value for the measles-related measure identified by the source column. Units vary by source.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_state.parque.long_description: Combined state-level measles indicators from multiple sources in long format. The source column identifies the measure type: wastewater_detection_rate (% wastewater samples positive for measles RNA; CDC NWSS), vaccine_exemption_rate (% kindergartners with MMR exemptions; Fattah et al.), jhu_measles_cases (weekly confirmed case counts from JHU), mmr_coverage_healthmap (estimated % children with MMR coverage; HealthMap), cdc_measles_cases (national weekly CDC case counts), cdc_measles_cases_nnds_cum (state cumulative case counts from CDC NNDSS). Units and time resolutions differ by source.

bundle_measles/dist/measles_county.parqu.short_description: Value for the measles-related measure identified by the source column. Units vary by source.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_county.parqu.long_description: Combined county-level measles indicators from multiple sources in long format. The source column identifies the measure type: wastewater_detection_rate (% wastewater samples positive; CDC NWSS), vaccine_exemption_rate (% kindergartners with MMR exemptions; Fattah et al.), jhu_measles_cases (weekly confirmed case counts; JHU), mmr_coverage_healthmap (estimated % children with MMR coverage; HealthMap), wapo_county_vax_rate (county MMR vaccination rate; Washington Post). Units and time resolutions differ by source.

bundle_measles/dist/measles_imported_ind.long_name: Cumulative year-to-date measles cases by importation status (State/National)
bundle_measles/dist/measles_imported_ind.short_description: Cumulative year-to-date count of measles cases classified as imported or indigenous, by state or nationally.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_imported_ind.long_description: State- and national-level cumulative year-to-date counts of measles cases from the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS), classified as imported (exposure occurred outside the US) or indigenous (domestically acquired). The source column identifies which classification the value represents. new_value gives the count newly reported for that MMWR week (the difference from the prior week's cumulative count, reset at the start of each year).

bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_name: Measles case or hospitalization count (cumulative or new, by age and vaccination status)
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.short_description: Count of measles cases or hospitalizations, either cumulative year-to-date or new for the reporting week, stratified by age group and vaccination status.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.long_description: Count of confirmed measles cases or associated hospitalizations in the United States, stratified by age group and vaccination status. The type column indicates whether the value is a cumulative year-to-date count or a newly reported count for the reporting week, and whether it counts cases or hospitalizations ('cumulative cases', 'new cases', 'new hospitalizations', 'cumulative hospitalizations'). Negative values may reflect retroactive corrections by the CDC. Cases are classified as confirmed or probable following CSTE case definitions. Vaccination-status counts are approximated by multiplying cumulative totals by the reported percentage in each status category.
bundle_measles/dist/measles_cases_by_age.statement: In the United States, {value} measles cases were reported.

cdc_measles_age2.name: CDC Measles Cases and Outbreaks - Age and Vaccination Status
cdc_measles_age2.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
cdc_measles_age2.description: Weekly new and cumulative case counts for measles in the United States, stratified by age group (<5, 5-19, 20+, and Total) and vaccination status (Total, Unvaccinated/Unknown, One dose MMR, Two doses MMR). Data are updated weekly on the CDC Measles Cases and Outbreaks surveillance page. Negative values in case counts reflect retroactive corrections by the CDC. Cases are classified as confirmed or probable following CSTE case definitions. New weekly counts are derived from successive differences in cumulative counts. Vaccination status case counts are approximated by multiplying cumulative totals by the reported percentage in each status category.
cdc_measles_age2.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
